name: Dual Space Span Disguise
description: Transforms the joint kernel condition into a linear span condition in the dual space. The mathematical equivalence relies on the fact that the linear span of a set of covectors $\varepsilon_u - \varepsilon_v$ contains the pairwise differences of essential indices if and only if those indices are in the same connected component in the corresponding graph. This preserves the Steiner Tree structure while hiding graph connectivity behind formal algebraic terminology, forcing models to deduce the graph-theoretic isomorphism.
